retain: The r1 cell positions, full zero-macroscopic-field W0 including microscopic electrostatics, fixed reference current normalization, old F/G/K domains and neutral unrestricted replacement instruction.
known_material: A passive scalar absolute background permittivity epsilon is independent of deformation; q0^2/(epsilon*a0*E0)=1. There are no mobile carriers or separate surface dielectric layers. Thermal fluctuations of the macroscopic offset are negligible.
electrical_connection: Each preparation uses either an ideal zero-voltage short or a passive external capacitor. In capacitor mode, the crystal upper electrode and the load upper face are one metallic node; their lower faces form another node. Both complete nodes have zero fixed net free charge and can redistribute charge internally. No source or ground connection is present. The amplifier in the crystal upper lead measures conventional current into that electrode.
load_definition: For S fixed reference lateral cells and N cells through the slab, CL=cL*epsilon*a0*S/N with known cL in[.5,2]. The load is mechanically separate and CL is fixed during deformation. The macroscopic limit holds cL fixed.
equilibration: Start with the connected specimen fully equilibrated at F. Then impose F(t)=F+small_amplitude*G*sin(omega*t). Take small amplitude and subsequently quasistatic frequency after the size limit, with charge/internal relaxation complete. No leakage or circuit inertia.
output: The same signed coefficient of current/(fixed reference area), normalized by small_amplitude*omega*q0/a0^2, as r1. Include all current into the crystal electrode; no subtraction of capacitive current.
parameter_and_data: K in[.8,1.2] remains the sole fitted material parameter. Fixed sigma.001, independent repeated calibration in ideal-short mode. The proposal does not place the private true K or limiting correction in public files.
keep_private: Reduced joint energy or capacitor divider
